MacIsland uses your current location to show local weather when Automatic location is selected.
MacIsland by Nima Jafari uses the camera only while you open the Mirror feature.
MacIsland by Nima Jafari uses Apple Events only for connected features you allow during setup, such as saving a Quick Note in Notes or controlling your chosen media app.
